## What landed

`crates/hh-runner/src/render.rs` — `hh-harness-render/1`. One pure
renderer per first-pass harness (admission x slot -> `{argv, env,
files}`) mirroring its Harbor adapter at `ff2a1ef4`, line-reviewed
offline against the pin (locators in the run ledger):

- **Closed env (REQ-XC-308):** harness base-URL/key vars with the slot
  token as sole credential, egress hints, mandatory
  `no_proxy=127.0.0.1,localhost`, declared `NAME=value` disable
  switches, image `HOME`/`USER` — nothing else; the shared
  `validate_cell_env` guards it (CC1).
- **Effort (REQ-XC-309/XD-082):** each harness's native mechanism at
  the pinned `high` beside the proxy pin; `receipt_effort` reads the
  receipt's `mutations.effort{requested,applied}`.
- **Instruction (REQ-XC-320):** byte-exact per adapter (mini `--task=`
  shlex-quoted; Pi positional — hazard pre-check flags a leading `-`;
  Claude Code env-var -> `printf | claude --print`); NUL/non-UTF-8
  hazards refuse.
- **mini-swe-agent (REQ-XE-001/XD-121/XC-310):** builtin `mini.yaml`
  sha256 + full `-c` spec list + Harbor flags on the participant
  identity; image digest+lock; `litellm_version` from the installed
  env; recordings keyed by it refuse mismatches;
  `LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True` via the declared switch.
- **Claude Code (REQ-XC-327):** `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` only, API key +
  OAuth emptied, five alias model vars + `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` = the
  participant model, nonessential traffic + web tools off,
  `qx26_black_box` refusal on any HIR-target use; `sm_pos_assert` —
  every Anthropic-host mediator row denied + counted in
  `expected_denied`, every receipt `/v1/messages` or refused
  `count_tokens` (upper-bound estimate).
- Slot-record members: `rendered_config_hash` (secrets elided),
  `rendered_files_digest` (the ST2 composite), `check_cell_listing`,
  `check_recording_key`.
